This is the amazing gift I got from Twitter Secret Santa in 2020

![](/img/portfolio/secret-santa.jpg){width="80%"}

Postage Stamps 1985-1989 'Native Birds'

Handstitched to vintage linen, mounted on harakeke paper and bordered with rauru.

"I make the paper and rauru from a flax bush in my garden. The linen came from my great grandmother. Every work I make is individual."

#SecretSantaNZ2020

# Update

Here is the full thread that I posted on Twitter

Opening day! #SecretSantaNZ2020

![](/img/tss2020/tss1.jpg){width="80%"}

A handmade card, with what looks like a photo Santa took themselves #SecretSantaNZ2020

This is embarrassing... Santa, you didn't have to give money, the artwork is truly amazing and I love it so much. Handmade paper and rauru and great-grandmother's linen, that's completely special.

> Nathan I had already made the artwork as my 'Secret Santa' gift but on reflection it may not be what you like. So I give you the gift of re-gifting if so :) Spend the \$10 on yourself- chocolate, peanut butter, beer, whatever floats your boat. I've added this description of the artwork.
>
> Artwork - Postage Stamps 1985-89 'Native Birds'
>
> handstitched to vintage linen, mounted on harakeke paper & bordered wih rauru.
>
> I make the paper from a flax bush in my garden. The linen came from my great grandmother. Every work I make is individual.
>
> I hope you & your whanau have a great christmas together.
>
> Warmest regards, LC
